errors.evidence: The description attempts to trace every single data point for all three lines, resulting in an extremely long, repetitive, and difficult-to-read paragraph. A more concise summary of trends with key points (start, end, peaks) would be clearer.

The description uses "triangle markers" for both the 'On-policy RL' and 'SFT' lines, but fails to distinguish that 'On-policy RL' uses upward-pointing triangles and 'SFT' uses downward-pointing triangles. This makes it harder to map the description to the specific lines.
